name: carom
description: 발행된 3D 당구 페이지(3쿠션·4구)의 랭킹 저장소 — 제출된 점수를 믿지 않고, 같이 온 큐질 기록을 페이지와 동일한 물리·규칙으로 재현해 검증한 뒤에만 기록한다. 물리 엔진(physics.js)·규칙(rules.js)·상대 AI(ai.js)가 이 모듈에 있고 페이지는 build.mjs 로 그것을 인라인한 산출물이다.

actions.name: 랭킹 등록
actions.description: 이긴 경기를 랭킹에 올린다. 시작 배치와 큐질 기록 전체를 같이 받아 서버가 같은 물리로 재현하고, 이닝·하이런이 재현 결과와 일치할 때만 저장한다 — 숫자만 보낸 제출은 거부된다.

actions.name: 랭킹 조회
actions.description: 저장된 기록을 애버리지(목표점수÷이닝) 순으로 돌려준다 — 같은 점수를 몇 이닝에 냈는지가 당구의 실력 척도라서다. game 으로 종목을 좁힌다.

actions.name: 자체 점검
actions.description: 물리 결정론·양 종목 판정·시작 배치 위조 거부·순서 위조 거부·랭킹 파일 읽기를 검사한다.

name.description: [submit_score] leaderboard display name, 12 characters at most; angle brackets are stripped

game.description: [submit_score|top_scores] which game: 'three' (three-cushion) or 'four' (Korean four-ball). Omit on top_scores to list both.

target.description: [submit_score] the run-to score the match was played to (1-200)

level.description: [submit_score] opponent rating the match was played against, for display only (e.g. '3쿠션 25')

innings.description: [submit_score] innings the winner took. Recomputed from the replay — a mismatch rejects the entry rather than being trusted.

high.description: [submit_score] the winner's longest run. Also recomputed from the replay.

layout.description: [submit_score] opening ball positions as [{id, p:[x,y]}] in metres. Must equal the standard opening for that game.

shots.description: [submit_score] every cue stroke of the match in order, as [{who, angle, speed, side, vert}]. This is what gets replayed; 600 at most.

limit.description: [top_scores] how many rows to return (1-100, default 20)

saved.description: submit_score — the stored row, with innings and high as the replay computed them

verified.description: submit_score — always true when saved; a failed replay returns an error instead

scores.description: top_scores — ranked rows {rank, name, game, target, level, innings, high, average, at}

total.description: top_scores — how many records exist for that filter

checks.description: selftest — one row per check {label, pass, note}
